groups.note: Bread (Roggenvollkornbrot, Weizenbrot, Toastbrot, Baguette, Naan).
Grains, flours, flakes, müsli and cornflakes, sweetened and fortified ones included.
Pastries and biscuits (Zwieback, Salzbrezeln, Butterkekse, Blätterteig).
Pasta, noodles and dumplings (Teigwaren, Schupfnudeln, Semmelknödel, Ravioli) — and every egg (Hühnerei, Wachtelei, Eigelb, Eiklar), which belongs under dairy.
Fruit, raw and prepared.
Vegetables, raw and prepared, some canned mixes and vegetable juice.

Legumes, sprouts and soy (beans, lentils, peas, tofu) — and much else that belongs elsewhere: nuts and seeds (nuts), olives and bamboo shoots (vegetables), coconut (fruit), plant drinks (drinks), plant-based dairy alternatives (dairy), meat substitutes (other), glass noodles (grains).
Potatoes, other tubers (Maniok, Batate, Topinambur) and edible mushrooms (vegetables); starches and their flours, gnocchi (grains); frozen and instant potato products.
Milk, yoghurt, cheese and cream in their fat contents and processing variants.
Ready-to-drink beverages — coffee, tea, soft drinks, juice drinks, water.
Alcoholic drinks — beer, wine by colour and dryness, fortified wines, spirits, liqueurs, cocktails.
Oils and fats — and the butters (Süßrahmbutter, Sauerrahmbutter, compound butters) and vegan cheese alternatives, which belong under dairy; bottled mayonnaise and remoulade.

Salt, pepper, dried herbs and seasonings — and condiments, sauces, stock cubes and spreads (canned), vinegar (oils), baking aids such as leavening, gelatine, pectin, food acids and candied peel (baking), fresh ginger (vegetables), and pastry fillings and glazes.
Sugars, honey, syrups, cocoa, jams, marzipan and baking chocolate (baking) — and, most of the group, finished confectionery and ice cream.
Fish and seafood — fin fish, shellfish, crustaceans.
Raw meat cuts across species.
Poultry, game and offal.
Sausages, cured meats and deli products (Salami, Schinken, Speck, Wurst).
Labelled broths, but mostly composed dishes — gratins, stews, soups, sauces, salads; its plain stocks (Hühnerbrühe, Gemüsebrühe, Fischbrühe) belong under canned.
Composed dishes and desserts (Sauerbraten, Kaiserschmarrn, Frikadellen, puddings); Fleischbrühe (Rind) is its one plain stock, canned.
